newsitem.title: NORWAY: FORECAST-Kvaerner 9-mo pre-tax seen at NOK 847 mln.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-Kvaerner 9-mo pre-tax seen at NOK 847 mln.

text.p: Norwegian shipbuilder and engineering group Kvaerner ASA is expected to book pre-tax profits of around 847 million crowns for the first nine months of the year, according to a Reuter poll of 10 Norwegian and international analysts.
No comparative figure for the year-earlier period was available due to the inclusion in 1996 figures of British conglomerate Trafalgar House, which Kvaerner acquired in April.
The analysts forecasts operating profits up to September 30 of 847 million crowns.
Five of the analysts recommended a buy on the share, three said hold and one said sell. One declined to provide a recommendation.
Analysts said there was still some uncertainty over the impact of the Trafalgar buyout on Kvaerner's results, especially from three Trafalgar divisions -- construction, process and metals.
Another question mark was hanging over the group's pulping division, they said.
Kvaerner will release nine-month figures on November 11. Following lists analysts' expectations.
